answer: Burn to enter, earn it back: borrowing Counterparty's 2014 proof-of-burn, each new agent identity must provably destroy a fixed sum, set near what an honest agent earns in its first ten epochs, and only peer-attested answers rebate it. The fable of free money behind a sybil farm meets a ridge of sunk cost: no identity is a free pearl, so every fake must out-earn its own burn with real work, and lazy copies stay in the red. Assumption: the burn asset is one the farm can't print.
